observations.finding: The MLZ route and dome remain recognizable. A retained entrance body still has stretched, dark photographic walls.
Open sides, slender posts and roof framing expose the brick base. Previously solid canopy volume walls are absent. Retained entrances and source triangles remain conspicuous.
Dome seam contrast is softer than71, but the material remains too uniform for a convincing aluminium finish.
The curved transparent canopy roof and surrounding campus layout remain legible from both aerial views. Adjacent FRMII geometry and other scan fragments remain coarse.
The canopy and dome render at sunset; the retained entrance remains visibly coarse.
Buildings and sky remain visible through the roof glazing. Thin framing has patchy triangular shading that requires diagnosis; floating scan fragments remain outside the roof boundary.

All12 standing/body checks pass in daylight, including three entry positions crossing former false walls and three under-roof positions. Six new captures show the canopy underside, exposed brick and framing artifacts.
